capabilities: Run a local proxy server on port 50905 inside Obsidian
Receive images from the WriteTex app via mDNS discovery
Convert math and diagram images to LaTeX, TikZ, or Markdown with an AI model
Insert recognized code at the cursor with real-time streaming
Send surrounding note text as context to improve recognition accuracy
extras: Manual installation from GitHub releases; screenshots of math are processed by an external AI service, with details deferred to a linked privacy policy.
problem: Getting handwritten or printed math and diagrams from a tablet into Obsidian requires manually transcribing them into LaTeX or leaving the editor.

relations.evidence: Seamlessly connects the WriteTex mobile app to your desktop Obsidian editor.

summary: Bridge plugin that runs a local proxy server so the WriteTex OCR app can send math images and insert LaTeX, TikZ, or Markdown at the cursor.
